name: IntegrateIT Client for the ESPHome Native API
notes: Local Control4 client for a single ESPHome device over its Native API (TCP :6053, plaintext protobuf). Enumerates the device's switch, binary_sensor, sensor, and text_sensor entities, maps up to eight of them into labeled Control4 slots with typed variables and Changed events, and drives switch entities On/Off/Toggle. Plaintext + legacy password auth only. MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
